Merge dates are UTC, newest first:

1. **#1934** "(fix) Framework and E2E test fixes", merged 2026-10-05 22:55:55. Matched in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.test.ts` (removed line 13 and added line 13, where the import was renamed to `getExtensionConfigFromStore`; removed lines 1317, 1346 and 1359). The commit has 26 matching lines in total; the rest were not returned. Its linked tickets are O3-5975 and O3-5982, taken from the PR text.
